paper_title: Thinking Slow, Fast Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
caption: : Coverage.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates coverage as a function of the number of completions (k) for four different model configurations. The x-axis represents the number of completions (k), displayed on a logarithmic (base-2) scale ranging from 2^0 (1) to 2^8 (256), with tick marks at each power of 2. The y-axis represents coverage on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 0.40 to 0.90. Four lines are shown. The first line, labeled 'Llama-3B', is depicted in dark blue with solid line style and circle markers; it starts at approximately 0.43 at k=1 and increases steadily to approximately 0.90 at k=256. The second line, labeled 'Llama-3B + FT', is shown in green with a dashed line style and square markers; it starts at approximately 0.48 at k=1 and rises to approximately 0.90 at k=256, tracking closely with the Llama-3B line but starting slightly higher at low k values. The third line, labeled 'Llama-1B', is displayed in light blue with a solid line style and circle markers; it starts at approximately 0.42 at k=1 and increases to approximately 0.88 at k=256, generally running slightly below the 3B lines. The fourth line, labeled 'Llama-1B + FT', is shown in light green with a dashed line style and triangle markers; it starts at approximately 0.47 at k=1 and reaches approximately 0.88 at k=256. All four lines exhibit a monotonically increasing trend that appears to plateau at higher values of k, with the steepest increases occurring between k=1 and k=16.
